Fields.Name: Event Layer ID
Fields.Description: Event layer of the ceremony. No game read of this value was found.

Fields.Name: Map Studio Layer ID
Fields.Description: Map (MSB) layer of the ceremony. No game read of this value was found.

Fields.Name: Play Region ID Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the multiplayer area (Play Region) ID found for the player's position, which is used for online play. 0: no change.

Fields.Name: Override Map Place Name ID
Fields.Description: Replaces the place name (Place Name text) of the player's current location. -1: no override; any other value, including 0 and other negatives, replaces it.

Fields.Name: Override Save Map Name ID
Fields.Description: Replaces the location name ID kept for the save data. -1: no override; any other value replaces it.
